svg.text: One echo period of the centre field, and the harmonics it is made of
At D 232.631 the critical solution repeats itself after one period, each time 5.4 times smaller (e^Δ, Δ = 1.68799). The solver computes one period.
Over it the field p1 at the centre is a sum of waves: harmonic k runs k times through the period. p1 changes sign after half a period, so only odd k occur.
p1 at the centre: the sum of all its harmonics
one echo period: θ = 2π τ / Δ, from 0 to 2π
The harmonics alone, each on its own vertical scale:
harmonic 5: size 8.0e-04, held at the fit
harmonic 13: size 5.9e-08, held at the fit
Harmonics 7, 9 and 11 lie between 5 and 13 in size; 15 and up are set to zero.
